sections.title: Teach
paragraphs: This is a simple way to remember how to abide in Christ. Follow these 5 steps daily when you are alone with the Lord. If your family also believes in Jesus, you can do this as a family.

subitems: What did I learn from this Scripture?
How will I obey what I have learned?

items.text: Take one truth with you throughout the day.

sections.title: Make a Plan
paragraphs: These scriptures are from a famous teachings of Jesus called the Sermon on the Mount. To practice abiding, study each of these scriptures one at a time by following the 5 steps. Read one passage each day and meditate on it. When you finish this list, continue reading the New Testament and try to read at least one chapter each day.
